_comment: Tunables for scripts/card_map.py — the relationship card map (hub card, trunk, panels of cards, Admiralty badges). Colours follow the IntelGraph house palette (scripts/theme.py). Change a value here, not in code. Keys beginning with _ are documentation.

theme._comment: Paint. Muted, print-safe, no gradients or shadows. hub_* is the dark subject card at the top of the trunk.
theme.title: #22333f

badges._comment: Admiralty badge fill by the SOURCE letter of the grade (A1..F6): A green, B blue, C orange, D-F grey. Text is badge_ink.

sizes._comment: Geometry in SVG user units (px at scale 1). width = canvas with a full-width grid panel; narrow_width = canvas when every panel is one card column (so a page-width embed prints the text larger), widened by center_width - trunk_gap when a center panel exists; center_width = the trunk column when a center panel exists, trunk_gap when not. char_* are the average glyph-width factors used to estimate text width for wrapping (no font metrics in the stdlib).

legend._comment: Footer legend wording (one figure, one meaning per mark).
legend.badge_text: Admiralty grade: source reliability A to F, information credibility 1 to 6

type_icons._comment: Builder default: an actor/supplier TYPE (lower-case substring match, first hit wins) -> the built-in icon. Anything unmatched uses `default`.

logo._comment: Local logos only: realpath must remain inside the spec directory or the enclosing cases/<id>/report directory. PNG/JPEG/SVG signature required, regardless of extension. Never fetch.

pii._comment: Card builders and --mask replace e-mail, phone and birth-date values. Full dates are removed only on person cards (icon person or explicit initials) or immediately after a birth cue (optional on/in, punctuation), or before a bracketed birth cue. Other full dates and plain year ranges stay. Phone candidates containing full dates or two year groups are not phones.

pii_full_dates._comment: Full dates require day, month and a 19xx/20xx year. Numeric YYYY-MM-DD and DD-MM-YYYY/MM-DD-YYYY (also slash/dot); English day-month-year and month-day-year. Month/year and year-only ranges are not full dates.

wide_scale_keys._comment: Size keys multiplied by sizes.wide_scale when a map has a full-width grid panel and is drawn on the wide canvas (sizes.width). At the house report's figure width that canvas is shrunk ~1.6x more than the narrow one; scaling type, chips, avatars and spacing keeps card, chip and legend text at about 7 pt or more in print. width, narrow_width, center_width (so side panels keep their room) and the char_* factors are never scaled.
